system_thesis_interpretation: V6 is a narrow prerequisite-governance proposal, not an experiment on the Dream-LoRA-Think paper thesis. It preserves that thesis only as inactive context: later-outcome-grounded local claims, deterministic compilation, identical text/graph/LoRA content, bounded goal-conditioned reconstruction, held-out actions, an explicit graph primary baseline, and LoRA credited only for transport or access. The active V6 object is finite pure-CPU symbolic implementation conformance. LOCAL is target-local calibration, not atoms, graph/RAG, or a fair benchmark baseline; MOTIF_SCHEMA is handed the complete persistent graph and does not learn schema; RANDOM_SOURCE is an exhaustively evaluated exact product measure, not stochastic execution. Even a future exact all-pass could establish only conformance of one implementation to these bound finite invariants and golden bytes through the isolated comparator. It could not establish a security property, benchmark result, learned representation, development, model capability, scientific claim, paper result, promotion, or successor authority, and no renderer, life, target agent, model/provider/tokenizer, DREAM/SLEEP/reader/memory, retrieval, LoRA/weights, GPU, remote service, or random/rendered world is in scope.
graph_delta_interpretation: The canonical predecessor is the exact 132-byte base_state.json at SHA-256 c5468731c271bf0bd39f97f672a36ad89305304ec3f6b282a31bffa96363d7d8: protocol FELTCRAFT_UNIMPLEMENTED_PROPOSAL_BASE_V1 with the exact key set and nodes, edges, loops, claims, and implemented_change_ids all empty. V6 validates those bytes before applying standalone replacement; V1-V5 are proposal ancestry only. The complete final runtime registry is exactly six added nodes and eleven added directed edges: SKN01 authority releases definitions and sealed copies; SKN02 is the oracle-blind enumerator; SKN03 houses four isolated oracle-blind projection principals; SKN04 is the oracle-blind twin/cost/bridge checker; SKN06 alone combines copied independent expectations with immutable observations from public candidate surfaces; and terminal SKN05 receives only fixed aggregates/eight SK01-SK08 receipts plus its separately bound golden bytes. Every edge endpoint closes over the six-node registry. There is no comparator-to-candidate feedback edge, no expected value or code enters any candidate, per-case mismatches remain comparator-local except for human governance, and SKN05 has no outgoing or scientific endpoint. SK10 and HUMAN_GOVERNANCE_REVIEW are external visibility stages, not runtime nodes or edges. Thus V6 supplies the realizable comparison path missing from V5 without inheriting any stale node, edge, or operation.
